title: Junior Backend Developer (Python) (M/W/D) 20H Stellenbeschreibung Read Description Before
description:
uNaice ist Pionier im Bereich der automatisierten Contentproduktion und automatisierten Datenaufbereitung und -anreicherung.

Wir entwickeln Kunden, die sich auf der Welle der Digitalisierung befinden. Unsere Kunden sind u.A. Top-Player im E-Commerce wie adidas, Wago, TUI, C&A, aber auch Verlage wie Neue Westfälische Zeitung, Volksstimme und vor allem internationale Hersteller, mit sehr großen Datenmengen und Bedarf an internationalem Content.

Unsere Arbeit versetzt die Pioniere der Branche in die Lage, automatisiert Daten und/ooder Content zu normieren, zu glätten, zu strukurieren und anzureichern und dies alles vollautomatisch. Kurz gesagt: Wir können aus Texten Datensätze mit Attributen und Attributswerten machen, oder aus Daten auf Knopfdruck unique, conversionstarke und SEO-relevante Produktbeschreibungen und Kategorieseiten erstellen und publizieren. Und das in 110 Sprachen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen Entwickler/Developer für 20h in Festanstellung.

Dein gemeldeter Wohnsitz ist in Deutschland. Du arbeitest auch in Deutschland.

Dein Anschreiben wünschen wir uns in deutscher Sprache.

Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

Als Junior Backend Developer, mit gleichzeitigen Kenntnissen in React, wirkst du aktiv mit bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres Backends rund um DataContentNaicer. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören:

  • Entwicklung und Wartung von Backend‑Services mit Python (z. B. REST / GraphQL APIs)
  • Integration und Verarbeitung von Datenquellen (verschiedene Formate wie JSON, CSV, XML etc.)
  • Aufbau und Optimierung von Datenpipelines & Datenmodellierung (Datenbereinigung, Attribut/Auswahl von Feature‑Parametern etc.)
  • Zusammenarbeit mit dem Frontend-Team: Sicherstellen, dass APIs performant, stabil und gut dokumentiert sind
  • Schreiben von Tests, Code Reviews und Mitarbeit in einem agilen Team
  • Deployment, Monitoring und Troubleshooting von Backend-Komponenten
  • Qualitätssicherung des Front-Ends in React

Qualifikation

Dein Profil

Must-haves:

  • Abgeschlossenes Informatik-Studium oder vergleichbar
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python (z. B. mit Frameworks wie Flask, FastAPI oder Django)
  • Gute Grundkenntnisse mit React
  • Erfahrung mit API‑Design (REST oder GraphQL)
  • Vertrautheit mit Datenformaten wie JSON, CSV, XML
  • Grundkenntnisse in der Arbeit mit Datenbanken (relational oder NoSQL)
  • Gute Problemlösefähigkeit und Lust, in einem wachstumsorientierten Produktteam mitzuarbeiten
  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Nice-to-haves:

  • Erfahrung mit Datenverarbeitungslibraries wie Pandas, NumPy etc.
  • Erfahrung mit Automatisierung, Datenpipelines, ETL‑Prozessen
  • Kenntnisse in Cloud‑Technologien (z. B. AWS, Azure oder vergleichbares)
  • Erfahrung mit Versionierung (Git), CI/CD, Testing‑Frameworks
  • Interesse an Textautomatisierung, semantischen Daten / Ontologien etc.

Benefits

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Einflussreiche Rolle in einem zukunftsorientierten Produktteam bei einem innovationsgetriebenen Unternehmen
  • Arbeiten an DataContentNaicer – einer Lösung, die echtes KI-Potential zur Datenoptimierung erschließt (bis zu 80 % Zeitersparnis, Attributerweiterungen, API‑Integration)
  • Agile Arbeitsweise, offene Kommunikation und Raum für kreative Lösungen
  • Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen und moderne Technologien
  • Karriereperspektiven – Entwickle dich mit uns weiter und sammle wertvolle Erfahrungen für deine Zukunft.

title: Java Fullstack Software Engineer (Spring Boot / Angular)
description:
................

Für unseren Kunden aus der Logistikbranche in Bern, suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n, motivierte:n und aufgeschlossene:n Java Fullstack Software Engineer (Spring Boot / Angular).

In diesem Projekt arbeitest du an der Entwicklung einer modernen, skalierbaren Softwarelösung zur datenbasierten Routenplanung und Optimierung komplexer logistischer Prozesse. Gemeinsam mit einem interdisziplinären Scrum DevOps Team gestaltest du eine neue Systemlandschaft auf Basis einer Microservice-Architektur und setzt moderne Technologien sowie Machine Learning ein, um effiziente und zuverlässige Planungslösungen zu ermöglichen.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung moderner Java-Applikationen innerhalb einer Microservice-Architektur
  • Konzeption und Implementierung von Backend-Services mit Java, Spring und Spring Boot
  • Entwicklung und Integration von Frontend-Komponenten mit Angular
  • Implementierung und Anbindung von RESTful APIs sowie Dokumentation mittels Swagger
  • Einsatz von Apache Kafka zur ereignisbasierten Kommunikation zwischen Microservices
  • Containerisierung und Betrieb von Anwendungen mit Docker und Kubernetes
  • Mitarbeit an der Entwicklung datenbasierter Optimierungslösungen im Zusammenspiel mit Machine Learning
  • Sicherstellung einer hohen Codequalität durch Unit Tests, Code Reviews und etablierte Entwicklungsstandards
  • Aktive Mitarbeit in einem interdisziplinären Scrum DevOps Team sowie Mitverantwortung für die Erreichung der Sprintziele
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Softwareentwicklern, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysten und UX-Spezialisten
  • Kontinuierlicher Wissensaustausch und Mitgestaltung technischer Lösungen und Architekturentscheidungen

Dein Profil:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Software Engineering oder vergleichbare Qualifikation durch praktische Erfahrung
  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Java-Softwareentwicklung
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Java, Spring und Spring Boot
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Angular und der Entwicklung moderner Webanwendungen
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Apache Kafka sowie im Aufbau und Betrieb von Microservice-Architekturen
  • Erfahrung mit RESTful APIs und Swagger
  • Kenntnisse in Docker und Kubernetes sowie modernen DevOps-Umgebungen
  • Hoher Qualitätsanspruch an Softwareentwicklung, insbesondere Clean Code, Unit Testing und Code Reviews
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit agilen Entwicklungsmethoden und Scrum
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

title: Forward Deployed Engineer – AI Agents & Enterprise Software
description:
You love building something people can actually use: the moment an integration works, an agent takes a tedious task off someone’s hands, or an idea becomes a useful tool. At XALT, you work closely with the people you build for, taking their solution from the first conversation into production.

Your customers will be enterprises and public-sector organisations. Your focus will be AI agents with XALT Northstar or development platforms in the Atlassian ecosystem. We will work out together which area fits your experience and interests; working across both is possible. What you learn in customer projects will feed back into our own products.

What we are working towards

We want to help companies use AI to improve the work people rely on every day. We combine consulting, software development and our own products to make that happen. What excites us is seeing a technical idea become something people can count on.

What you will do

  • Turn business problems into practical technical solutions together with the customer.
  • Write production code and integrate agents into existing systems and workflows.
  • With a Northstar focus, build and operate personal and operational agents using MCP servers, Agent Skills, evals, guardrails and observability.
  • With an Atlassian focus, develop platforms and workflows using Forge, Rovo and CI/CD so development teams can use agents reliably.
  • Take solutions into production, evaluate their quality and improve them based on actual use.
  • Bring insights from customer projects into our products.

What you bring

  • Experience writing and reviewing production code, for example in TypeScript or Python, across both backend and frontend
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers and CI/CD, for example AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform or GitLab
  • Practical experience with LLMs and agentic systems, including evals that detect errors and regressions
  • At least one agent or AI workflow you have built yourself and put into production, which you can demonstrate live during the application process (see “Your AI example”)
  • Enjoyment of working directly with customers and the ability to make reasoned technical decisions with incomplete information
  • Business-fluent German and English

What we offer

  • Unlimited tokens for Claude, OpenAI and the latest, most advanced AI tools
  • €70,000–100,000 gross per year, depending on experience; we are open to going beyond this range for exceptional senior candidates with a proven record of running agents in production
  • The opportunity to follow your solutions from the first conversation into customers’ daily work and see the difference they make
  • Professional exchange within the team, across the Atlassian ecosystem as a Platinum Partner, and through the XALT AI Circle and IT Revolution

### Your working arrangements

We value working together in the office: developing ideas, learning from one another and talking things through in person. Living in or around Munich or Leipzig is therefore a plus. Remote work is also possible. If you live further away, we would still love to hear from you. Together, we will discuss an arrangement that works for you, your team and the role.

  • Full-time
  • Work within an international company with teams in Munich, Leipzig, Manila and New York

### Our professional community

Exchanging ideas with others is part of what we enjoy about this work. For our XALT AI Circle in Munich in autumn 2026, we have invited Peter Steinberger of the OpenClaw Foundation to discuss personal agents. In October 2026, Philipp Göllner spoke at the Enterprise AI Summit in Charlotte about how our team built a Chief of Staff agent. We plan to represent XALT again at the summit in Portland in May 2027. title: Software Engineer - Simulation Platform
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent

YOUR IMPACT

  • Shape the future of Proxima’s simulation platform: we design and develop the platform; stellarator researchers and engineers use it to mature the design of Alpha and Stellaris; you will imagine and build with us novel solutions for simulation tools that spark joy and reduce time-to-insight

  • Accelerate Stellarator R&D, at the company at its forefront: we work side by side with researchers and engineers to ensure what we build immediately boosts the speed Proxima Fusion’s Stellarator design program

WHAT YOU WILL DO

You will join the Simulation Platform Team, a software platform team that balances development of core products with direct support to researchers, adapting to the Stellarator design program’s strategy and priorities. In your first six months you will e.g. add features to our in-house simulation pipeline automation system and ensure that AI agents can work with it efficiently.

  • On the platform engineering side you will design, develop and maintain next-generation software solutions for stellarator simulation and design, targeted to human and agentic use; for example:

    • Python libraries enabling automation of large-scale simulation workflows

    • cloud-based data storage that keeps everyone in sync

    • web applications that foster cross-domain collaboration and knowledge discovery

title: Backend Engineer - Partner Flow
description:
Backend Engineer - Partner Flow Team

Hybrid in London / Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join the Partner Flow team.

This role is a chance to shape how thousands of small businesses find their way to iwoca. You'll join the team that owns iwoca's partner integrations — the Lending API and embedded flows that let third-party platforms, from major banks to fintechs, offer iwoca loans inside their own customer journeys. You'll own projects, collaborate with stakeholders, and design robust systems to deliver important functionality and measurably improve the experience for our partners and customers.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

iwoca partners with a variety of third-party platforms, ranging from large banks and comparison sites to small fintechs that serve SME customers. These partners use iwoca’s Lending API to embed iwoca loans into their own customer journey. Partnerships are an important and fast-growing source of customers for iwoca.

The Partner Flow team builds new features and optimises existing flows to provide the best possible experience for iwoca's partners and the customers they refer to us. The team’s responsibilities include:

  • Continually improving our Lending API and other developer tools, so that partners can integrate with iwoca quickly and easily.

  • Adding new functionality to facilitate deeper integrations and ensure iwoca is the best embedded finance provider on the market.

  • Improving the conversion rate of customers who come to us through partners - streamlining the journey, running RCTs (randomised control trials) and building models alongside our embedded data scientist to find what works.

The team is made up of three engineers, a data scientist plus a team lead, working closely with an internal team of commercial stakeholders. This role is one of two new engineering hires as we grow the team to meet our ambition.

Partner Flow is remote/hybrid-friendly, meeting up for team days in the office once or twice a month, but not on a fixed schedule. They work in an Agile fashion with two-week sprints and a daily standup.

The role

You’ll work on challenging projects all over iwoca’s codebase - anywhere there are improvements to be made for partners and partner-referred customers. You’ll be encouraged to bring your own ideas and take responsibility for areas of functionality.
